title: Falcon 40B Open-Source Release
summary: The Technology Innovation Institute announced on May 25, 2023 that Falcon 40B was available as an open-source large language model for research and commercial use.
significance: A documented open-release milestone for a 40-billion-parameter large language model developed by the Technology Innovation Institute in the United Arab Emirates.
organizations: AI and Digital Science Research Center

geography.note: TII's May 25, 2023 release is datelined Abu Dhabi, UAE. This field records only the announcement location and does not assert training or development geography.

verification.note: TII's first-party May 25, 2023 announcement directly states that Falcon 40B was made open source for research and commercial use and describes it as a 40-billion-parameter foundational large language model trained on one trillion tokens. A later first-party TII release dated May 31 documents a licensing change to royalty-free commercial and research use; that later licensing milestone is not substituted for the May 25 open-source release date. Abu Dhabi is recorded only as the announcement location. No ancestry, influence, causality or traversable relationships are inferred.

sources.title: UAE's TII Launches Open-Source "Falcon 40B" Large Language Model for Research & Commercial Utilization
UAE's Falcon 40B is now Royalty Free

candidateMeta.admissionReason: First-party evidence directly supports the May 25, 2023 open-source release milestone, while a separate TII announcement preserves the later May 31 licensing change as context rather than conflating the dates.
candidateMeta.nextStep: Consider chronology-safe canonical admission as an open-source release milestone. Preserve Abu Dhabi strictly as announcement-location and do not infer development/training geography or causal relationships without separate evidence.
